name: Memory (DuckDB)
description: Side-by-side DuckDB memory owner candidate with canonical JSONL ingest ordering, read facade SQL, and slot-selected host surfaces.

storagePath.label: Storage Path
storagePath.help: Base directory for canonical records, JSONL spool, checkpoints, and shadow state.

duckdbPath.label: DuckDB Path
duckdbPath.help: DuckDB file used by the read facade when a local native binding is available.

runtimeMode.label: Runtime Mode
runtimeMode.help: Select canonical owner mode or the shadow-read read-only mode for the absorbed memory runtime.

native.required.label: Require Native DuckDB
native.required.help: Fail status checks if DuckDB native bindings are unavailable on the current host.

ingest.maxActiveBytes.label: Max Active Spool Bytes
ingest.maxActiveBytes.help: Rotate the active JSONL spool segment after this many bytes.

replay.batchSize.label: Replay Batch Size
replay.batchSize.help: Maximum replay batch size when applying canonical spool entries to the shadow ledger.

shadow.maxCheckpointAgeSeconds.label: Max Checkpoint Age Seconds
shadow.maxCheckpointAgeSeconds.help: Threshold used by the status surface to flag stale or missing persisted shadow checkpoints.

shadow.requireParityZeroMismatch.label: Require Zero Mismatch Parity
shadow.requireParityZeroMismatch.help: Only advance the persisted shadow checkpoint when parity is ok and mismatch count is zero.

diagnostics.enableHttpRoutes.label: Enable HTTP Routes
diagnostics.enableHttpRoutes.help: Register plugin-owned status, search, and SQL read-facade HTTP routes when selected.
